Comment: kms:Decrypt uses Resource '*': Resource * is safe here ONLY because of the kms:ViaService condition below: it permits decrypt exclusively through SSM in this region. Pinning the AWS-managed key ARN would require kms:DescribeKey at deploy time, which is a wider permission than the thing it protects.

Statement._comment: Region is wildcarded because Bedrock on-demand quota is granted PER REGION and is 0 for these models in us-west-2 on this account while being 400 rpm in eu-west-1. The model ids stay pinned, so this widens where inference may run, not what may be invoked. deploy.sh strips this _comment; IAM rejects unknown members in a Statement.

backend/evidence.py re-queries a claimed metric change before a memory may be promoted to 'verified'. Resource is '*' because CloudWatch's Get/List metric APIs do not support resource-level permissions -- a metric has no ARN -- so '*' is the only value AWS accepts. Both actions are read-only. deploy.sh strips this _comment before applying: IAM rejects unknown members inside a Statement.
